newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-BOWE WANTS RETURN TO U.S. MARINES, PAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-BOWE WANTS RETURN TO U.S. MARINES, PAPER SAYS.

text.p: Former heavyweight boxing champion Riddick Bowe, who last month left a U.S. Marine boot camp after only 11 days, wants another chance at becoming a Marine, the New York Daily News reported Thursday.

The newspaper quoted him as saying in an interview that "all I think about is becoming a Marine" even though homesickness and the strict discipline drove him away from the camp at Parris Island, South Carolina, on February 21.
"This is for me," Bowe said. "I really would like to be a Marine and make the Marine Corp proud. If they gave me another opportunity, I know I can do it."
Gunnery Sgt. Hugh Hawthrone of the U.S. Marine Recruiting Command said it was "virtually impossible" that the Marines would give Bowe another chance, the Daily News reported.
